description: manni docs meta/set-up/machine-authorship, run in a repo with docs/limits.md and a config that does not yet manage provenance.

steps.description: Configure it: manage provenance from git, and name the machines.
get reads the record from git before anything is stamped.
The agent rewrites lines 9 to 11 of docs/limits.md.

runShell.command:
node -e "const f=require('fs'),p='docs/limits.md';f.writeFileSync(p,f.readFileSync(p,'utf8').replace('The limit is 100 requests a minute.
Bursts of 20 are allowed.
A 429 response carries Retry-After.','The limit is 120 requests a minute.
Bursts of 30 are allowed.
A 429 response carries a Retry-After header.'))"

steps.description: derive attributes the uncommitted lines to the machine --generated-by names (the flag form of MANNI_GENERATED_BY).

runShell.stdio: /provenance  lines 9-11: \(unset\) → claude-fable-5  \(git: uncommitted\)[\s\S]*1 file, 1 changed, 1 range written/

steps.description: Commit the edit and its stamp together.

runShell.command: git -c user.name=eval -c user.email=eval@example.invalid commit -qam "Rewrite the limits"

steps.description: get shows the record in file lines, asserted by the stamp.
A range git already attributes to another machine is refused.

runShell.stdio: /docs\/limits\.md:13-15: blame attributes these lines to claude-fable-5 \([0-9a-f]+\); --generated-by cannot overrule a recorded machine\./

runShell.command: git -c user.name=eval -c user.email=eval@example.invalid commit -qam "Attribute the support line"

steps.description: A person rewrites one of the agent's three lines and commits.

runShell.command: node -e "const f=require('fs'),p='docs/limits.md';f.writeFileSync(p,f.readFileSync(p,'utf8').replace('Bursts of 30 are allowed.','Short bursts of 30 are allowed.'))"

steps.description: validate fails at the first line of the range.

runShell.stdio: /provenance lines 16-18 changed since claude-fable-5 wrote them — run manni meta derive  \(line 16\)  \[derived:stale\]/

steps.description: The rewritten line dropped out of the record, and validate passes.
